introHtml: Numo specializes in durable plastic drinkware with a vinyl-like finish that resists scratches and fading. Their tumblers and mugs work well for promotional giveaways or corporate gifts because the smooth surface accepts full-color decoration with crisp detail. Whether you need 20 oz double wall tumblers for a trade show or 16 oz travel mugs for a company picnic, Numo products offer consistent quality and a premium feel that stands out from standard plastic cups.
